title: Binary Walsh basis
statement: For each natural number $n$, the Walsh characters indexed by subsets $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ form a basis over $\mathbb R$ for the space of real-valued functions on the binary cube $\{0,1\}^n$, where the character indexed by $S$ is $x\mapsto(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$.
